title: Sequans Sells 970 Bitcoin to Slash Debt, Bitcoin Price Slumps to $101,000
summary: Bitcoin MagazineSequans Sells 970 Bitcoin to Slash Debt, Bitcoin Price Slumps to $101,000Sequans Communications sold 970 BTC to cut its convertible debt in half, leaving a 2,264 BTC treasury and improving its debt-to-NAV ratio while freeing capital for buybacks.This postSequans Sells 970 Bitcoin to Slash Debt, Bitcoin Price Slumps to $101,000first appeared onBitcoin Magazineand is written byMicah Zimmerman.
